categories.main_business_segments: The Group's primary business segments include securities broking, margin financing, commodities and futures broking, bullion trading, and leveraged foreign exchange trading. It also engages in IPO brokerage and provides administrative services through various subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group heavily invests in proprietary online trading platforms, notably the BS Securities (Baobao) and BS Futures (Doudou) mobile applications, which are regularly upgraded for enhanced functionality, speed, and cybersecurity. The trading systems are connected to major global financial markets and hosted in the HKEX central data centre, with rigorous stress and penetration testing to ensure stability and security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves a broad customer base including retail and institutional investors engaging in securities, futures, options, bullion, and forex trading. It also targets investors interested in IPOs and global financial products, providing education and simulation competitions to enhance investor knowledge.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates primarily in Hong Kong with a network of 13 physical outlets covering core areas including Central, Kowloon, and the New Territories. Its trading platforms provide access to global financial markets, and it maintains strong ties with Mainland China through stock connect schemes and cross-boundary wealth management initiatives.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates as a midstream financial services provider, acting as a brokerage and intermediary facilitating client transactions in securities, futures, options, bullion, and forex markets. It also provides margin financing and investment advisory services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous enhancement of digital trading platforms with a focus on cybersecurity, expanding diversified global financial products, and integrating online and offline marketing strategies. The Group emphasizes investor education through seminars, simulation competitions, and a dedicated finance channel to improve financial literacy and client engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through brokerage commissions, interest income from margin financing, handling and settlement fees, and dealing income from bullion and leveraged forex trading. The Group also earns income from IPO brokerage and proprietary investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group positions itself as a leading Chinese-based securities firm in Hong Kong, recognized for its proactive and client-oriented approach. It competes by offering competitive commissions, innovative digital platforms, and comprehensive client services. It has received multiple industry awards, including from HKEX and CME, underscoring its strong market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 March 2025, the Group reported revenue of HK$972.3 million, a 7.0% increase year-on-year, and a net profit of HK$617.6 million, up 10.5%. Client accounts grew by 4.4% to 587,072, with client assets increasing 27.9% to approximately HK$64.2 billion. The Group maintains a strong net profit margin of 63.5% and continues to invest heavily in system upgrades and marketing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group differentiates itself through its advanced, reliable, and secure online trading platforms offering 24-hour trading and real-time streaming quotes for Hong Kong and U.S. stocks. It provides competitive pricing, extensive product offerings including global futures and options, and personalized client services via a broad branch network and mobile teaching centre. Its commitment to investor education and social responsibility further enhances its brand trust and client loyalty.
